info.title: 0bull API
info.description:
Manage TikTok, Instagram and YouTube accounts, publish videos, and control phones directly
over HTTP.

## Authentication

Send your API token as a bearer token on every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
```

Create a token under [Settings, API tokens](https://0bull.net/settings/api-tokens) and copy
it right away: it is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.

A token can be scoped to one or more abilities:

- `phones:read`: list phones, view snapshots and on-screen text, and check run status.
- `phones:control`: send input, commands, macros and agent runs to a phone.
- `accounts`: link, list, update and remove posting accounts.
- `submissions`: create, list and cancel video submissions.
- `billing`: view billing and request phone rentals or count changes.

A request whose token lacks the required ability gets a `403`.

## Rate limit

60 requests per minute. Going over that returns a `429` with a `Retry-After` header.

## Async work

Anything that touches a phone or a platform runs in the background. The call returns as
soon as the work is accepted, and you poll to see the result:

- Submission changes: poll the submission.
- Phone work (macros, device commands, agent runs): returns `202` with a run record. Poll
  `GET /v1/phones/{slot}/runs/{run}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`.

## Errors

Failures come back as JSON with a `message`. Invalid input adds a field-keyed `errors`
object.

- `422`: validation failed.
- `403`: the token is missing the required ability, or the account cannot access that resource.
- `409`: conflict, such as cancelling a submission that has already finished.
- `502`: the phone or platform could not be reached.

post.description:
`platform` chooses where the account posts and defaults to `tiktok`. The
account must already be signed in on the phone at `slot`, or have no slot
yet for a record-only entry: this endpoint links an account, it does not
sign one in.

`handle` is required on every platform. YouTube also requires
`google_email`, the Google account address of the channel; every other
platform rejects it.

post.description:
Uploads the video and queues it for publishing. Pass `platform` to choose
`tiktok` (the default), `instagram` or `youtube`, and `account_id` to name
the account, which must be assigned to a phone.

This returns 201 with status `pending`; publishing happens afterwards, so
poll `GET /v1/submissions/{submission}` for the outcome.

On YouTube, `caption` is the Short's title: required, and capped at 100
characters instead of 2200.

platform.description: Platform to post to. Defaults to `tiktok`.
platform.title: Platform

video.description: Video file, up to 200 MB. Accepted types: MP4, MOV.

caption.description:
The text posted with the video. On TikTok and Instagram this is the
caption, up to 2200 characters, and optional. On YouTube it is the
Short's title instead: required, and capped at 100 characters.
